correct.description: Lying on the bench, bar lowered with control to the chest and pressed back to full lockout, even bar path, controlled lumbar arch within a safe range

common_errors.description: Bar does not reach the chest -- insufficient range of motion
Bar drifts horizontally instead of tracking a consistent vertical-ish path
One arm presses higher or faster than the other
Lower back arches excessively off the bench -- a spinal-safety concern
common_errors.status_note: Excessive lumbar arch during a bench press is a well-established safety concern, but the precise geometric threshold is uncertain from position-only landmarks lying down (the standard shoulder/hip/knee angle proxy is even less reliable in a supine, heavily-occluded camera view -- EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §2's 'partial (bar + bench occlude)' warning applies directly here). PT sign-off required before this exercise goes vision-live at all (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §5 gate 5) -- this fault specifically needs that confirmation before any threshold is invented.

keypoint_signature.rule: PROXY ONLY, not PT-confirmed: angle(shoulder, hip, knee) deviates from a neutral-spine reference by more than threshold.bench_lumbar_arch_tolerance -- do not implement against this rule without PT sign-off, and note the occlusion caveat above even once confirmed.

common_errors.description: Elbows flare out beyond a safe angle from the torso -- a shoulder-strain concern
common_errors.status_note: Elbow flare beyond a certain angle is a recognized shoulder-impingement risk factor during pressing, but the exact safe-angle threshold (and how it should vary by grip width, which this schema has no way to know) needs PT-confirmed semantics before implementation -- not a number to guess. PT sign-off required before this exercise goes vision-live at all (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §5 gate 5).

keypoint_signature.rule: PROXY ONLY, not PT-confirmed: angle(shoulder, elbow, torso_midline) > threshold.bench_elbow_flare_deg -- do not implement against this rule without PT sign-off.

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated. bench_lumbar_arch_tolerance and bench_elbow_flare_deg are intentionally null -- see the excessive_lumbar_arch and excessive_elbow_flare faults' status_notes.

rep_counting._note: "top" = full lockout (rest/reference, highest elbow angle), "bottom" = bar at chest (peak flexion) -- same top=rest/bottom=effort convention as pushup.json (bench press mirrors push-up's own polarity).

coaching_cues.setup: Lie on the bench, feet flat, grip just outside shoulders
coaching_cues.execution: Lower the bar with control, press to lockout
coaching_cues.set_complete_no_flags: Strong set. Clean bar path every rep.
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.depth: Lower the bar all the way down
flag_cues.bar_path_drift: Keep the bar tracking straight up and down
flag_cues.excessive_lumbar_arch: Keep your hips down on the bench
flag_cues.excessive_elbow_flare: Tuck your elbows in a little more

shoulder_injury.modification: Reduce range of motion or use dumbbells for a more natural path. Stop if you feel shoulder pain.

back_injury.modification: Keep feet flat and avoid excessive arching. A PT-supervised spotter is strongly recommended.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding (Valsalva). Breathe out as you press up.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only (ADR-100/102). Cannot override rep count or safety flags -- and per this contract's hard rule, cannot substitute for PT confirmation on the two high-severity faults' thresholds either. Default off until expert-agreement eval passes; this exercise additionally requires PT sign-off before any form flag ships at all (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §5 gate 5).

camera_guidance.framing_note: Phone ~2m away, diagonal from the head or foot of the bench, raised to above bench height. Expect heavy occlusion: the bar and bench hide the torso from a pure side view.
